description: Use when you want one ETF's registry metadata and portfolio surface, and optionally its largest holdings. Not for finding an ETF ticker (use riskmodels_search) or the ETF's daily returns (use riskmodels_get_returns). Returns { snapshot, holdings }: snapshot from GET /data/etf/{ticker}; holdings, only when holdings_top is set, from GET /data/etf/{ticker}/holdings. Holdings follow the latest published holdings file; registry refreshed end-of-day. Free (no per-call charge).

holdings_top.description: Also return the largest N holdings, integer 1-200, e.g. 25 (default: no holdings)

ticker.description: ETF ticker symbol, case-insensitive, e.g. SMH

name: riskmodels_get_etf
title: RiskModels ETF
